channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Clive James — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-02
item.description: “It's only when you look at an ant through a magnifying glass on a sunny day that you realise how often they burst into flames.” — Clive James

item.title: Byron Pulsifer — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-01
item.description: “If you cannot be silent be brilliant and thoughtful.” — Byron Pulsifer

item.title: Henry David Thoreau — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-31
item.description: “If one advances confidently in the direction of his dream, and endeavours to live the life which he had imagines, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.” — Henry David Thoreau

item.title: Neil deGrasse Tyson — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-30
item.description: “The good thing about science is that it's true whether or not you believe in it.” — Neil deGrasse Tyson

item.title: Seneca — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-29
item.description: “It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare; it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.” — Seneca

item.title: Mark Twain — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-28
item.description: “Never argue with stupid people, they will drag you down to their level and then beat you with experience.” — Mark Twain

item.title: Nelson Mandela — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-27
item.description: “There is no passion to be found playing small — in settling for a life that is less than the one you are capable of living.” — Nelson Mandela

item.title: John Lennon — Quote of the Day, 2026-10-26
item.description: “Yeah we all shine on, like the moon, and the stars, and the sun.” — John Lennon
